title: 短暂的在场
standfirst: 潮汐退去，船只经过。有人穿过光，有人在窗边停留。
standfirstEn: Tides recede. A boat passes. Someone crosses the light; someone pauses by a window.
introduction: 沙洲在水中显出轮廓，渡船把一位乘客带向河岸，雨后的路面暂时收留了霓虹。这些照片拍摄于不同的地方，却反复回到同一种相遇：在事物即将改变的片刻，与它保持一段可以凝视的距离。
十四幅作品沿水面、人的日常与光线展开。地名留在图注里；照片之间，航迹与街道、窗框与鸟居、树影与人的身影彼此应答。观看也成为一次停留，容许一个地方显露出地图之外的样子。
introductionEn: A sandbank takes shape in the water. A ferry carries a passenger towards the shore. A wet road holds the neon for a moment. Made in different places, these photographs return to a similar encounter: staying close enough to look as something begins to change.

Fourteen photographs unfold through water, daily life and light. Place names remain in the captions. Between pictures, wakes answer streets, windows answer gates, and shadows of trees answer human figures. Looking becomes a pause in which a place can appear beyond its position on a map.

chapters.title: 水面，余迹
chapters.text: 从高处看，海水接近一张平面；礁石、船只与航迹又把距离带回来。到了岸边，岩石、浅水与亭子的倒影让目光慢下来。同样是水，有时留下经过的痕迹，有时把周围的事物暂时留住。
chapters.textEn: From above, the sea approaches a flat surface; reefs, a boat and its wake bring distance back into the picture. At the shore, rocks, shallow water and a reflected pavilion slow the eye. Water carries traces of passage, or holds its surroundings for a moment.

chapters.title: 与人擦肩
chapters.text: 狭窄的街道、渡船的座椅、灶台前的一步，构成了各自的日常。相机经过这里，留下人与周围空间的关系：谁被建筑围住，谁望向画外，谁正忙于手边的动作。观看停在擦肩的距离。
chapters.textEn: A narrow street, a ferry seat and a step beside a stove belong to different daily routines. The camera passes through, attending to people in their surroundings: a figure enclosed by buildings, a gaze beyond the frame, a hand absorbed in a task. The view stays at the distance of passing by.

chapters.title: 光的停留
chapters.text: 光在墙面上划出边界，让人物成为剪影；一道天光照入石块之间，朱红的门框把庭院收进画面。林间的树影则把草地分成明暗。空间由此有了入口、深度，以及一段适合停留的时间。
chapters.textEn: Light marks a boundary on a wall and turns people into silhouettes. Daylight falls among stones; vermilion gates gather a courtyard into the frame. In the woods, shadows divide the grass into light and dark. These spaces acquire an entrance, a depth and a moment in which to stay.

artistStatement: 我是 Power，生活和工作在上海。这份选辑从海岸、街巷与日常空间中展开，把相距很远的地方放在一起观看。
在这些照片里，我关心的是人与环境之间的距离，以及光如何改变一个地方的样子：一位渡船上的乘客、一道通向庭院的门、船驶离后留在水面的线。它们使一个短暂的片刻有了可以反复观看的形式。
artistStatementEn: I’m Power, based in Shanghai. This selection moves through coasts, streets and everyday spaces, bringing distant places into the same field of view.

In these photographs, I’m concerned with the distance between people and their surroundings, and how light changes the appearance of a place: a ferry passenger, a gate opening onto a courtyard, a line left on the water after a boat has passed. A brief encounter becomes a form we can return to.
